About us

Bitget is the world's largest Universal Exchange (UEX), serving over 125 million users and offering access to over 2M crypto tokens, 100+ tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, FX, and precious metals such as gold. The ecosystem is committed to helping users trade smarter with its AI agent, which co-pilots trade execution.

Aligned with its global impact strategy, Bitget has joined hands with UNICEF to support blockchain education for 1.1 million people by 2027. Bitget currently leads in the tokenized TradFi market, providing the industry's lowest fees and highest liquidity across 150 regions worldwide.

What you'll do

• US Equities & Global TradFi Asset Monitoring, Analysis, and Listing Recommendations
• Build and optimize global trending asset recommendation models to support the listing of spot, contract, and equity assets
• Monitor events and data impacting financial markets and trending sectors; recommend assets worth prioritizing for operational focus

• Drive rapid implementation of user needs across Product, Operations, and BD departments, forming a closed-loop feedback mechanism

• Conduct review and evaluation work for crypto assets and equity assets prior to exchange listing
• Cross-Departmental Support
• Provide research support to VIP, Marketing, and Brand teams

What you'll need

• Strong understanding of the crypto ecosystem and exchange business operations; familiar with product features, competitive strengths/weaknesses, and operational strategies of major mainstream CEXs
• Solid understanding of traditional financial markets, with keen insight into macroeconomics and trending sectors
• Excellent logical analysis, data insight, and written communication skills; able to quickly produce well-structured, professional reports
• Strong initiative and sense of ownership; able to proactively identify issues and drive execution
• Fluent spoken English
Nice to Have
• Background or work experience in traditional finance, or a strong passion for trading with deep involvement in equity markets
• Basic coding proficiency
• Prior research experience at an exchange, Web3 institution, or leading research platform
• Published industry reports or personal influence/following (e.g., X/Twitter)

Bitget currently leads in the tokenized TradFi market, providing the industry's lowest fees and highest liquidity across 150 regions worldwide.

What you'll do

• Local Market Discovery: Run user interviews, usability testing and competitor benchmarking in your markets to find friction points and opportunities, then distill them into specific, quantified requirements rather than generic feature requests.
• PRD Writing & Regional Modularity: Write clear, detailed PRDs that connect what the local market needs with how the central engineering team should build it. Favor jurisdiction-configurable designs (feature flags, per-entity product eligibility, configurable onboarding tiers) over one-off forks.
• Localized Onboarding & UX: Partner with the Compliance Product team to localize onboarding and verification flows (local ID documents, language, suitability or appropriateness checks, tax information collection) so they meet local requirements while maximizing conversion.
• Payments & Product Availability: Define local fiat on/off-ramp needs and the regional product shelf, including what can be offered to whom under local rules.
• Go-To-Market & Delivery: Own the product lifecycle end to end: ideation, sprint planning, local beta, commercial rollout, and post-launch tracking of conversion funnels, retention and trading volume.
• Roadmap Advocacy: Build data-backed business cases to secure global roadmap priority for your region's market and regulatory needs.

﻿What you'll need

• 4+ years of product management experience in consumer-facing crypto, brokerage, fintech or payments products, with direct ownership of at least one market launch.
• Solid understanding of digital asset products (spot, derivatives, leverage, staking, custody).
• Experience designing regulated onboarding flows (KYC/KYB, identity verification) that pass local audits without excessive retail friction.
• Strong analytical skills: SQL plus product analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel) to diagnose funnel drop-off and measure impact.
• Ability to act as the connective tissue between local business leads, local Legal/Compliance, and global Product and Engineering teams.
• Strong negotiation and prioritization skills in a matrixed, multi-region organization.

岗位职责：
• 本地市场洞察：在目标市场开展用户访谈、可用性测试及竞品对标，精准识别摩擦点与机会，并将其转化为具体、可量化的产品需求，而非泛泛的功能建议。
• PRD 撰写与模块化设计：撰写清晰详尽的产品需求文档（PRD），将本地市场需求与全球工程团队的实现路径有效衔接；优先采用可配置的区域化设计方案（如功能开关 Feature Flags、按实体划分的产品准入、可配置的开户层级），避免为单一市场进行代码分支（Fork）。
• 本地化开户与用户体验：协同合规产品团队，优化本地化的开户及身份验证流程（包括本地身份证件支持、语言适配、适当性/适宜性检查、税务信息收集等），在满足本地监管要求的同时最大化用户转化率。
• 法币出入金与产品货架：定义本地法币出入金（On/Off-ramp）需求及区域产品货架，明确在不同监管规则下可向特定用户群体提供的产品类型。
• 全生命周期交付：负责产品从构思、迭代规划、本地 Beta 测试、商业化上线到上市后表现追踪（转化漏斗、留存率、交易量）的端到端管理。
• 路线图推动：基于数据构建商业案例，争取全球产品路线图对本地市场及监管需求的优先级支持。

任职要求：
• 经验背景：4年以上面向消费者的加密货币、券商、金融科技或支付类产品管理经验，并至少主导过一次完整的市场上线项目。
• 产品理解：深刻理解数字资产产品（现货、衍生品、杠杆、质押、托管）的业务逻辑。
• 合规开户设计：具备设计受监管开户流程（KYC/KYB、身份验证）的实战经验，能够在通过本地审计的同时，避免给零售用户带来过度的操作摩擦。
• 数据分析能力：熟练掌握 SQL 及产品分析工具（如 Amplitude, Mixpanel），能够诊断漏斗流失原因并量化产品改动的影响。
• 跨团队协同：能够作为本地业务负责人、本地法务/合规团队与全球产品/工程团队之间的核心连接枢纽。

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

📌 Please note: This is an on-site role based in Vienna, Austria. Due to the fast-paced hiring process and local regulatory requirements, candidates already eligible to work in Austria or the EU are strongly preferred.

•

About the Role

Bybit is seeking a Wallet Operations Manager to join our EU Finance team. The role combines hands-on wallet operations with digital asset management, ensuring secure and efficient asset transfers, settlements, reconciliations, and safeguarding of client crypto assets.

The successful candidate will work closely with Finance, Treasury, Risk, and Technology teams to support daily operations and maintain reliable wallet infrastructure and asset controls.

Key Responsibilities

•

Wallet Operations: Operate and manage hot, warm, and cold wallets, including wallet rebalancing, asset transfers, and transaction approvals.

•

Wallet Infrastructure: Work with institutional custody platforms, including MPC-based wallet solutions, transaction workflows, and wallet configurations.

•

Asset Settlements: Execute and monitor crypto asset settlements, internal transfers, and cross-chain transactions, ensuring timely and accurate processing.

•

Safeguarding: Support the safeguarding and segregation of client crypto assets in accordance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

•

Asset Reconciliation: Reconcile on-chain wallet balances with internal systems and custody records, identifying and resolving discrepancies.

•

Liquidity Management: Coordinate with Treasury to ensure sufficient asset availability across wallets and networks.

•

Operational Controls: Maintain secure transaction approval workflows, maker-checker controls, and wallet access permissions.

•

Process Improvement: Maintain SOPs, support automation initiatives, and improve the efficiency and reliability of wallet operations.

•

Operational Support: Investigate failed transactions, settlement issues, and other wallet-related incidents, coordinating with internal stakeholders as needed.

•

Support internal and external audits by providing relevant wallet and asset records.

Key Requirements

•

3+ years of experience in crypto wallet operations, digital asset custody, exchange operations, or a related field.

•

Bachelor's degree in Finance, IT, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

•

Strong technical understanding of blockchain networks, wallet infrastructure, private key management, MPC, and multi-signature solutions.

•

Hands-on experience with institutional digital asset custody platforms and wallet management systems.

•

Good understanding of crypto asset transfers, settlements, liquidity management, and blockchain transaction processes.

•

Experience with asset reconciliation, safeguarding, and operational controls.

•

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

•

Ability to work independently and collaborate across Finance, Treasury, Risk, and Technology teams.

•

Professional fluency in English; Mandarin Chinese is an huge advantage.

Nice to Have

•

Experience at a cryptocurrency exchange, custodian, or regulated financial institution.

•

Understanding of EU MiCAR safeguarding and segregation requirements.

•

Familiarity with on-chain monitoring tools and blockchain explorers.

•

Experience with process automation or operational reporting.

Why Join Us

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:

•

Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.

•

Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.

•

Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.

•

Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.

•

Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

As a Senior SAM Analyst on the CX Compliance team within Customer Experience, you’ll investigate complex financial crime activity and help strengthen AI-assisted investigations. You’ll own high-risk casework and apply human judgment to validate investigative outputs, support accurate regulatory reporting, and identify control gaps. Your findings will help Product, Compliance Technology, and ML Engineering improve investigation quality and efficiency while maintaining human oversight.

What you’ll do:

• Own end-to-end anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing (AML/CTF) investigations involving complex alerts, referrals, fraud typologies, and interconnected customer activity, including open-source research, identity verification, prior filing reviews, and blockchain analysis where needed.

• Draft and review investigative narratives and Suspicious Activity Reports/Transactions Reports (SARs/STRs), ensuring conclusions are evidence-based, clearly documented, and consistent with applicable requirements.

• Evaluate AI-generated narratives, evidence, risk assessments, and recommended dispositions using human-in-the-loop (HITL) quality scorecards to capture missed risk indicators, unsupported or fabricated facts, incorrect risk weighting, and inappropriate escalation decisions.

• Translate recurring investigation, model, data, and workflow defects into actionable feedback for Product, Compliance Technology, and ML Engineering.

• Support AI evaluation and release testing through annotation, calibration, user acceptance testing, and curated benchmark case reviews that inform model tuning and launch-readiness assessments.

• Escalate material issues affecting customers, regulatory filings, control effectiveness, or launch readiness, documenting evidence, potential impact, and recommended next steps.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 4+ years of experience in AML, transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, or financial crime compliance, including independent ownership of complex, high-risk, or multi-entity cases.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Demonstrated experience drafting and reviewing SARs/STRs and defending investigative conclusions through documented evidence and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Experience conducting quality reviews, second-reviewer checks, calibration, user acceptance testing, or model evaluation, including identifying systemic weaknesses and communicating reproducible, actionable findings.

• Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing cases and make risk-based escalation decisions under ambiguity or time pressure.

• Preferred: CAMS or another relevant AML, fraud, or crypto investigation certification; experience with SQL, Snowflake, fraud-ring analysis, entity resolution, or blockchain analytics.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

You will own the trade operating model, the end-to-end order and settlement flow, cash flows, corporate actions, reconciliations, and regulatory readiness across the business.

 - In-depth knowledge of traditional markets: execution, clearing, settlement, custody, margin, securities lending, and corporate actions.

 - Working understanding of digital assets and tokenized securities, including custody models, on-chain settlement, and the controls they demand.

 - Direct experience under SEC and FINRA rules: books and records, supervisory procedures, trade reporting, and examination response.

 - Experience standing up or scaling operations for a new regulated product or entity, including launch readiness and regulatory approvals.

Reflecting a multi-cloud environment (AWS, Alibaba Cloud, GCP) supporting live trading, custody, and customer-facing operations on a global scale.

About the Role

As Senior Manager, Platform & Infrastructure Audit, you'll be a hands-on, deeply technical individual-contributor auditor who owns critical assurance projects spanning the cloud infrastructure and DevOps lifecycle, from platform build and configuration through CI/CD pipelines and hands-on ITGC validation. You'll bring subject matter expertise to both dimensions of AI in scope: auditing AI (assessing how OKX's AI/ML systems are built, governed, and monitored) and auditing with AI (applying AI tools to your own scoping, testing, and reporting) while also flexing into adjacent domains such as cloud security and identity, resilience engineering, secure SDLC, and data engineering. You'll help shape the risk-based audit plan by identifying emerging infrastructure risks, and partner closely with Engineering, SRE, and Security stakeholders to deliver findings and recommendations that hold up in a fast-moving, high-technology crypto environment.

What You'll be Doing

•

Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering Audit (SME): Deep, hands-on expertise auditing cloud platforms (Alibaba Cloud, AWS), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm).

•

AI Use, Adoption & Governance: Two dimensions, both required.

•

Auditing AI: Assessing how AI/ML systems are built, deployed, and monitored — model and data lineage, training-data provenance and quality, access to models and prompts, human-in-the-loop and approval controls, evaluation and drift monitoring, and alignment to emerging AI governance and regulatory expectations.

•

Auditing with AI: A demonstrated bias toward using AI in your own audit work — scoping, evidence review, control testing, script generation, and reporting — and an interest in helping the function build reusable AI-enabled audit tooling.

What We Look For in You

•

Crypto & Blockchain Acumen: Prior experience at a crypto exchange or with a crypto product is preferred.

•

Critical Thinking for Complex Environments: A proven capacity to analyze novel technical and control environments unique to crypto, identify intricate root causes, and propose effective, context-specific remediation that engineering teams will actually adopt.

•

Breadth Across Adjacent Platform Domains: Demonstrable experience auditing control design and operating effectiveness in several of the following:

•

Cloud security and identity — IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, encryption and key management

•

Site reliability and resilience — observability, incident and problem management, capacity, backup and disaster recovery

•

Software development lifecycle — code review, branch protection, artifact integrity, secure SDLC, third-party and open-source dependency risk

•

Data engineering and analytics — integrity and quality of data pipelines and ETL processes

•

AI/ML platform and MLOps — model registries, feature stores, inference infrastructure, and the data feeding them

Nice to Haves

•

Cloud or Security Certifications: AWS or GCP professional-level certification, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), CISA, CISSP, or CCSK/CCSP.

•

Crypto and blockchain literacy: regulated financial-services, fintech, or crypto experience.

Risk Mechanism & Product Design

Design and iterate on core mechanisms such as rule engines, decision flows, risk tiering, holds and releases, and automated interdiction

Define the logic behind risk parameters (limits, velocity thresholds, triggers, escalation paths) and balance risk coverage against user friction

Design controls that operate under high concurrency and strict latency requirements across fiat on/off-ramp, card acquiring, card issuing, and payment transaction risk control

Work with Engineering on real-time data pipelines, rule execution performance, fallback and degradation strategies, and stability under peak load

Detect and close gaps around abnormal patterns such as velocity abuse, account takeover, card fraud, chargebacks, mule accounts, and structuring

Optimize risk-related communications delivered to customers during transactions

Produce high-quality PRDs that define functionality, performance, security, and other standards

Support audit and regulatory inquiries with clear documentation of risk logic

Data Analysis & Optimization

Continuously monitor product data and evaluate the effectiveness of risk strategies and product features

Define metrics (false positive rate, interception rate, fraud loss rate, case handling time, decision latency) and drive data-based iteration

Coinbase Creative Studio operates at the intersection of art, culture, and technology. We create original, high-impact work that helps define the Coinbase brand and bring our products to life in differentiated ways. Our portfolio spans large-scale brand and product campaigns with month-long timelines, as well as high-priority assets that need to move from brief to delivery the same day. We partner closely with internal creatives, producers, strategists, marketers, and some of the world’s leading agencies and production partners to deliver work across channels and formats.

As Design Operations Manager, you will own and evolve the operating model that enables our design and motion teams to do their best work. You will sit at the center of our creative ecosystem, connecting people, processes, partners, and priorities across a diverse portfolio of work. You will own resource planning for full-time and contract design and motion talent, set resource and capacity strategy across the portfolio, and help scale the studio through a global ecosystem of agency and production partners. You will own the process for how work is planned, resourced, prioritized, reviewed, delivered, and reported, and lead selected creative initiatives across multiple workstreams. You will bring structure and clarity to a fast-moving environment while protecting the quality, timeliness, and ambition of the work. This role is ideal for an experienced design operations leader who has delivered creative work for world-class brands and products across a range of media, and who knows how to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution.

What You’ll Do

• Define and own the design and motion operating model for Creative Studio, including how work is planned, resourced, prioritized, reviewed, delivered, and reported.

• Set resource and capacity strategy across a broad portfolio of creative work, balancing business priorities, timelines, skill sets, and team health.

• Build and scale a global ecosystem of contract talent, agencies, and production partners, including sourcing, onboarding, engagement, and management of external partner performance.

• Establish operating rhythms, planning systems, and reporting that give senior stakeholders clear visibility into capacity, priorities, risks, and delivery.

• Lead high-impact design and motion initiatives across multiple workstreams, ensuring the work meets a high bar for quality, scope, timeliness, and brand expression.

• Partner with creatives, producers, strategists, marketers, and senior cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex business priorities into executable creative plans.

• Identify bottlenecks and create scalable tools, processes, and solutions that increase the team’s speed, effectiveness, and ability to deliver exceptional work.

What We Look For in You

• Bachelor’s degree in design, business, communications, or a related field; relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

• Significant experience leading design operations, creative operations, production management, or a related function within a high-performing creative organization.

• A track record of delivering creative work for world-class brands and products across multiple media, channels, and complex business contexts.

• Proven experience developing resource strategy and managing global networks of contract design and motion talent, agencies, and production partners.

• Exceptional organizational judgment, with the ability to set priorities, anticipate tradeoffs, and create clarity across complex and shifting workstreams.

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead through ambiguity, and drive alignment across creative, marketing, production, and business teams.

• A high bar for creative quality, strong communication and problem-solving skills, and the ability to move work forward across in-house teams and agency partners through clear processes and influence.

Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

This is the first compliance hire for our North American businesses: a Canadian and a US money services business in a regulated payments group. You will hold three roles at both entities: Compliance Officer, Risk Officer, and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO). The job is to build the programs, then run them.
Both businesses are early. They move money across borders for business clients, with foreign exchange where needed, and their volumes are starting now. You will work with a small team and can bring in outside providers for monitoring and reviews, working under your direction.


What You Will Do
As Compliance Officer

• Build, then keep current, each entity's written compliance program: client and beneficial-ownership due diligence, enhanced measures for higher-risk clients, record keeping, travel-rule data, and training.

• Assess money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions-evasion risk across clients, products, channels, and geographies, and assess new products, payment rails, and corridors before launch.

• Set the outside compliance provider's scope, review its work, and sign off what it produces.

• Run the ongoing staff training program, and keep each entity's registrations current with FINTRAC, the Bank of Canada, and FinCEN.

• Lead regulator examinations and information requests, and answer due-diligence requests from banks, payout partners, and clients.

• Monitor US state money transmission licensing requirements and advise the business before it enters a new state or product.

As MLRO

• Run transaction monitoring and sanctions screening, and decide every escalated alert.

• Canada: file suspicious transaction and terrorist property reports with FINTRAC, and oversee the other prescribed reports.

• US: file suspicious activity reports with FinCEN, and oversee currency transaction reporting and OFAC blocking and reject reporting.

• Act as the contact for law enforcement requests and production orders, and protect the confidentiality of every report.

As Risk Officer

• Canada: act as the senior officer overseeing the risk management and incident response framework under the Retail Payment Activities Act, including incident reports, third-party risk, and any safeguarding-of-funds framework.

• Canada: file the annual report to the Bank of Canada by March 31, and give notice of significant changes or new activity ahead of time.

• Maintain each entity's risk register and risk appetite across compliance, operational, third-party, and partner risk, and report to the board.

• Commission the independent reviews required under each regime, and track every finding to closure.

What we expect from you
Must have

• At least 7 years in anti-money-laundering and sanctions compliance at money services businesses, payment companies, or the payments arm of a bank, including 3 or more as a compliance officer, MLRO, or deputy.

• Deep knowledge of Canada's Proceeds of Crime (Money Laundering) and Terrorist Financing Act and FINTRAC's guidance, and working knowledge of the Retail Payment Activities Act.

• Experience building a compliance program, not only running one: policies, risk assessment, and training plan.

• Experience deciding on and filing suspicious transaction reports, and running transaction monitoring and sanctions screening.

• Experience taking a business through a FINTRAC, bank-partner, or audit examination and closing the findings.

• Due diligence experience on business clients, including clients that pay out for their own customers, and on banks and payout partners.

• A recognised AML certification, such as CAMS, or equivalent experience.

• Clear writing for boards, regulators, and banks, and the ability to work alone across time zones.

• Able to pass the background checks that regulators and banking partners require.

Join the Coins Team Now!

Meaningful Collaborations - The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with other relevant teams to carry out implementations that will improve and create an impact on customer experience.

Scalable Growth - Be part of a fast-growing organization with the vision to expand its territories outside APAC which will provide opportunities for career advancement.

• Solid understanding of major blockchains (BTC, ETH, EVM chains, Tron, etc.) and on-chain transaction monitoring.

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE


Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 
 


THE OPPORTUNITY

As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and speed leadership: you set the bar for paid video on the team, work with AI-enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with video questions.

 

 - Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

 - Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.

 - Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

 - Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

 - Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

 - Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

 - Build creative with testing in mind. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

 - Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines.

 - Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

 - Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

 - A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

 - Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

 - High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

 - Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

 - Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

 - Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated.

 - Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

 - Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements.

 - A solid copywriting instinct for scripts and on-screen text. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

 
 



Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.




OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.


We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.


As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address

Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/


Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.kraken.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Model Risk Director focused on Fraud and AI to join OKX’s Model Risk Management (MRM) function. As a senior member of the second line of defense (2LOD), this leader will provide independent oversight and effective challenge of fraud models used to detect, prevent, and manage fraud risk across OKX’s products and customer journeys.

The role will lead end-to-end validation of fraud models, from conceptual soundness, data and implementation review to outcomes analysis, performance monitoring, and remediation follow-up. The portfolio may include supervised machine learning models, anomaly detection, graph and network analytics, rules-based or hybrid systems, and AI-enabled fraud applications.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience in fraud model validation, strong quantitative judgment, and practical experience assessing AI/ML models. This person will partner closely with Fraud, Risk, Product, Data Science, Engineering, Compliance, and Audit teams while maintaining the independence of the MRM function.

This is a hands-on, builder role: the successful candidate will independently establish the fraud model validation capability from the ground up, personally execute validations, and play a leading role in assessing AI-enabled systems.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Establish and own the independent validation framework for fraud models and AI-enabled decision systems across OKX products, covering conceptual soundness, data quality, implementation, and outcomes analysis, in line with SR 26-2 and equivalent model risk frameworks.

•

Assess model conceptual soundness, intended use, assumptions, and limitations.

•

Personally execute end-to-end model validations as the technical expert, including independently reproducing results through hands-on data analysis and code review.

•

Assess AI/ML and generative AI applications, including LLM-based and agentic systems, for robustness, reliability, explainability, and appropriate human oversight, applying strong applied AI evaluation expertise.

•

Perform ongoing monitoring review and periodic revalidation to ensure sustained model performance through changing fraud patterns and business conditions.

•

Provide effective challenge to model owners; communicate conclusions, limitations, and risk ratings clearly to senior management and governance forums, and track remediation through closure.

•

Build and continuously mature the fraud model validation capability, standards, and workflows within MRM.

What We Look For In You

•

Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

•

10+ years of quantitative, fraud risk, or model risk experience, with a recognized track record as a hands-on technical expert who personally delivers independent validations of models and decision systems.

•

Excellent communication and judgment, including the ability to explain quantitative findings to senior audiences and constructively challenge model owners.

•

Practical experience with statistical and machine learning methods; proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of SR 11-7 or equivalent model risk and AI governance frameworks.

•

Experience with AI/ML governance and controls, including explainability, fairness, robustness, ongoing monitoring, or generative and agentic AI applications in fraud operations.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience establishing validation frameworks, methodologies, or capabilities in settings where they did not previously exist.

•

Strong applied AI capability: hands-on experience evaluating or building ML/LLM-based systems in production, including prompt engineering, evaluation harnesses, fine-tuning assessment, or agentic AI workflows; able to run red-team style testing on AI applications.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

OKX Statement:

OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

•

The salary range for this position is $200,000 - $300,000

•

The salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Applicants should apply via OKX internal or external careers site.

About the Opportunity:
We are seeking a Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC) Analyst with a minimum of 2 years of experience in security monitoring, incident detection, and response. The role involves working within a fast-paced security environment to safeguard organizational assets from emerging cyber threats. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely detection, analysis, and escalation of security incidents.


Responsibilities:
• Perform triage, analysis, and escalation of security alerts across SIEM, EDR/XDR, WAF, email security, and cloud log sources, coordinating with our MSSP where relevant.

• Own incidents end-to-end — triage through resolution through "what changed afterward" — and turn that work into documented playbooks and updated detection logic, not just closed tickets.

• Develop, tune, and validate SIEM detection rules (ES|QL/EQL/KQL or equivalent), including running detection validation exercises against existing use cases to confirm they actually fire.

• Convert threat intelligence feeds and scheduled hunting queries (e.g., lookalike domain alerts, anomalous auth events) from passive detection into defined, actionable response — closing the loop between "we saw it" and "we did something about it."

• Support the build-out of an insider threat monitoring program, including identity and privileged-access anomaly detection.

• Understand our detection tooling and log source pipelines (maintained day-to-day by our MSSP) well enough to confirm they're onboarded correctly and actually working — you're not expected to build or maintain this tooling yourself, but you need to be able to verify it.

• Track and report CSOC performance metrics (MTTD/MTTR, false-positive rates, MSSP SLA adherence) to support continuous improvement of operations.

• Write and maintain operational documentation, playbooks, and detection rule rationale so institutional knowledge isn't concentrated in one or two people.

• Contribute to automation of repetitive triage and enrichment work (scripting, workflow tools) to reduce manual toil across the team.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and regional partners, where Chinese language skills may be required.

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 3-4 years of experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC) or equivalent security monitoring/detection engineering role.

• Hands-on experience with SIEM tools, including: 1. Detection rule and use case development, and the ability to reason about whether a rule actually detects what it claims to (detection validation mindset, not just rule-writing). 2. Query/rule-writing experience in ES|QL, EQL, KQL, or equivalent. 3. Alert triage, enrichment, and case management with ticketing systems. 4. Comfort reading raw logs (auth events, CloudTrail-style audit logs, process trees) without relying solely on pre-built dashboards.

• Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting for automation, log parsing, or extending existing tooling — enough to pick up and modify scripts someone else wrote, not build from scratch.

• Knowledge of common attack techniques, malware behavior, and network security principles, with familiarity mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK.

• Familiarity with incident response frameworks (e.g., NIST, SANS) and a track record of writing playbooks or documentation from real incidents.

• Exposure to identity/IAM log analysis or insider threat / UEBA concepts is a strong plus, given active program build-out.

• Good understanding of cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and comfort across varied operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS).

Nice to Haves
• Familiarity with atomic-level adversary emulation using Atomic Red Team or equivalent framework, for the purpose of validating that detections fire as expected.

• Effective communication and documentation skills.

• Chinese language proficiency (reading, writing, and/or speaking) is a strong advantage.

• Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CEH, or similar) are desirable.

Perks & Benefits
• Competitive total compensation package.

• Various team-building programs and company events.

• And many more! Apply and let us tell you more!

Manage the venue's public notice: review revisions, control versions, and make sure the notice matches how the product actually works. This includes corrections and material-change filings within the required deadlines.

Run the issuer notice process from start to finish, including tracking delivery, handling objections and confirming each stock's listing date.

Track and monitor TSV limits on an ongoing basis, including per-stock and volume limits against consolidated market data, periodic tier rechecks, trading halts and eligible stablecoins. Escalate breaches, significant operational events and required SEC notifications.

Coordinate the evidence FINRA needs before approval, such as the officer and director structure, authorized signatories on the broker-dealer's bank accounts, bank statements, the independent auditor engagement, the clearing agreement, and flow-of-funds and demo materials.

Build the broker-dealer's compliance program, including written supervisory procedures, the supervisory control system, an AML program under FINRA Rule 3310 with customer identification procedures, and books and records under SEC Rules 17a-3 and 17a-4.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

The Strategic Markets and Global Marketing teams are responsible for accelerating sustainable growth across OKX’s priority markets. We work across regions and functions to identify opportunities, develop market strategies, strengthen execution, and build repeatable operating models that can scale globally.

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to serve as a trusted strategic and operational partner to the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, market expansion, business performance, and organizational execution.

You will translate strategic priorities into clear operating plans, drive high-priority cross-functional initiatives, improve decision-making through rigorous analysis, and ensure alignment across regional and global teams. You will also act as a connective layer between the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing leadership teams and key partners across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and other functions.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment, analytical rigor, executive presence, and hands-on execution. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and taking ownership of complex initiatives from initial problem definition through to measurable results.

What You’ll Be Doing

Strategic Planning and Execution

•

Partner directly with the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing to define priorities, develop strategic plans, and translate objectives into clear initiatives, milestones, and areas of accountability.

•

Drive the annual and quarterly planning processes for Strategic Markets and Global Marketing, ensuring alignment between regional priorities and broader company objectives.

•

Lead complex, high-priority initiatives spanning multiple markets, business units, and functional teams.

•

Identify execution risks, dependencies, and organizational gaps early, and work with stakeholders to resolve them.

•

Ensure key decisions are translated into action, with clear ownership, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

Market Growth and Business Performance

•

Develop data-driven analyses and recommendations regarding market expansion, investment allocation, customer growth, partnerships, and other strategic opportunities.

•

Monitor market performance, commercial trends, competitive developments, and emerging risks across priority markets.

•

Partner with regional leaders to assess performance, identify growth opportunities, and strengthen local market strategies.

•

Build business cases and scenario analyses to support resource allocation and investment decisions.

•

Help develop repeatable market-entry and growth playbooks that can be applied across regions while accounting for local market conditions.

Operating Cadence and Governance

•

Establish and continuously improve the operating cadence for Strategic Markets and Global Marketing, including leadership meetings, business reviews, planning sessions, and regional performance reviews.

•

Develop dashboards and management reports that provide leadership with a clear view of performance, priorities, risks, and required decisions.

•

Create effective governance mechanisms for cross-functional initiatives, ensuring appropriate escalation and timely decision-making.

•

Maintain disciplined follow-through on leadership decisions, commitments, and strategic initiatives.

•

Improve the quality and flow of information among regional teams, functional partners, and senior leadership.

Executive Advisory and Decision Support

•

Serve as a trusted thought partner to the Executive Vice President of Global Markets and Marketing on strategic, commercial, operational, and organizational matters.

•

Synthesize complex information into clear insights, recommendations, executive briefings, and materials that support decision-making.

•

Prepare presentations, business reviews, strategic updates, and other materials for senior leadership.

•

Represent the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing leadership teams in selected meetings and initiatives, ensuring continuity, alignment, and follow-through.

Cross-Functional Leadership

•

Build strong relationships with regional leaders and global stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Business Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, HR, and Communications.

•

Act as a connector across teams, clarifying objectives, resolving competing priorities, and removing barriers to execution.

•

Lead special projects and time-sensitive initiatives that do not have a natural owner elsewhere in the organization.

•

Support organizational planning, resource prioritization, and ways of working as the Strategic Markets and Global Marketing function evolves.

•

Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and high performance.

What We Look For In You

•

Experience in strategy, business operations, management consulting, investment banking, technology, fintech, financial services, or a similarly fast-paced and analytical environment.

•

Demonstrated experience partnering directly with senior executives and influencing leaders across multiple functions and markets.

•

A strong track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution.

•

Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect market insights, customer needs, business performance, and company priorities.

•

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience developing business cases, performance analyses, and executive-level recommendations.

•

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex topics into clear decisions and action plans.

•

Strong executive presence and the ability to build trust with stakeholders across different functions, cultures, and levels of seniority.

•

High ownership, sound judgment, and a willingness to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels.

•

Ability to thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly, and maintain momentum in a rapidly changing environment.

•

High integrity and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.

•

Professional fluency in English.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience in crypto, fintech, digital assets, payments, or another highly regulated and rapidly evolving industry.

•

Experience supporting international expansion or managing initiatives across multiple geographic markets.

•

Prior experience as a Chief of Staff, strategy leader, business operations leader, or regional operator.

•

Familiarity with go-to-market strategy, growth planning, partnerships, and regional operating models.

•

Additional language capabilities relevant to OKX’s international markets.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

About the Role:

The Global CDD Manager leads CDD and EDD standards across all FIAT and banking partner relationships globally. The role ensures the company meets AML/CFT, sanctions and licensing obligations for retail and corporate customers, and for the financial institutions, payment providers and FIAT rails through which those customers transact. Beyond customer due diligence, the role owns the end-to-end risk management of the FIAT partner lifecycle: how partners are assessed before onboarding, how their risk is rated and re-reviewed on an ongoing basis, how information requests and escalations are handled between us and the partner, and how partner-driven events are contained without disrupting customer service or the wider payment network. The hire will work with local MLROs and compliance teams to align global standards with local requirements, maintains oversight of CDD controls, and acts as the primary point of contact for banking partners, auditors, regulators and internal stakeholders on compliance matters.

What You’ll Do:

Banking and fiat partner relationship management.

• Serve as the firm's compliance point of contact and escalation channel for banking and fiat partners across all jurisdictions, covering on-ramp and off-ramp, payment rails and settlement arrangements.

• Lead partner onboarding, periodic reviews, incident management and exit decisions, review contractual compliance obligations (CDD, data sharing, transaction monitoring, travel rule and audit rights), and maintain a current inventory of channels and relationships with concentration exposure by partner, corridor and currency.

Fiat partner lifecycle risk framework.

• Design and own a unified global framework for assessing fiat partner risk across the full lifecycle: onboarding due diligence, launch, ongoing monitoring and exit or migration.

• Standardise the onboarding due diligence methodology, define the risk drivers with a named accountable owner for each, calibrate the tiered risk rating matrix — including post-launch operational and settlement performance — and set review frequency by risk tier with defined triggers for ad hoc review.

Regulatory and stakeholder alignment.

• Ensure the framework satisfies material outsourcing requirements under the ADGM rulebook and equivalent local regimes, and align review cadence and escalation channels with Finance, Risk, Security and the Third Party Due Diligence function so that a single periodic review meets all stakeholder requirements.

Partner RFI and cooperation framework.

• Design and own the framework governing how banking and fiat partners raise requests for information and how the firm responds, in partnership with Customer Service, Bank Relations and Compliance.

• Establish onboarding service levels and communication protocols, define reason-code standards with a process to return incomplete or incorrectly coded requests, agree expected RFI ratios with partners in advance, negotiate reciprocal cooperation terms, and maintain continuity arrangements so response capability does not depend on individual availability.

Global CDD and EDD standards, assurance and remediation.

• Ensure global CDD and KYB standards are met across all entities, products and jurisdictions, aligned with local requirements through the MLRO community. Oversee the design and operation of customer risk rating and enhanced due diligence frameworks, including fiat-specific factors such as payment corridors, cross-border flows and counterparty banks, and provide guidance and challenge to the first line of defence.

• Manage relationships with external auditors and assurance providers, support regulatory and partner inspections, and own the global remediation tracker as the single source of truth for status, ownership, due dates and evidence, driving items to validated closure.

Product, automation and reporting.

• Partner with Product and Technology leadership to design and deliver global and local CDD, EDD and partner-risk enhancements with automation and scalability built in from design.

• Manage multiple cross-jurisdiction projects and vendor or platform solutions for partner monitoring and RFI handling, and report progress, risk position and remediation status to senior management and governance forums with clear KPIs, risk appetite thresholds and escalation triggers.

What We’re Looking For:

• 7+ years of CDD, KYC/KYB or financial crime compliance experience, including at least 3 years in FIAT, payments or banking.

• Hands-on experience managing third-party relationships with banks, payment providers or other regulated partners, including onboarding due diligence, periodic review and exit.

• Experience designing or operating a partner/counterparty risk framework, including risk rating matrices, risk drivers and periodic review cycles.

• Experience tracking and remediating audit, regulatory or programme findings across multiple teams and jurisdictions.

• Experience with external audits and regulatory examinations, including managing findings to closure.

• Deep knowledge of global AML/CFT, sanctions and CDD requirements, and of customer risk scoring frameworks.

• Knowledge of licensing requirements for financial services and crypto-related business across relevant jurisdictions, including outsourcing and third-party requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to align multiple stakeholder groups (Compliance, Finance, Risk, Security, Operations) on a single governance cadence.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical and problem-solving skills, and ability to make difficult decisions independently.

• ACAMS, ACFCS or equivalent industry certification.

Nice to Haves:

• Experience with correspondent banking, nested or sponsor-bank arrangements, or payment rails (for example SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, local rails such as PIX).

• Experience with FIAT on- and off-ramp flows, card or payment processing, or P2P and B-Pay style channels.

• Experience with RFI handling, reason-code standards or information-sharing frameworks with banks and law enforcement.

• Experience building risk or monitoring processes on an AI-first, automated basis, including data pipelines and exception scoring.

• Knowledge of ADGM (or equivalent) material outsourcing and third-party risk requirements.

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE


Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We are hiring several Senior Compliance Associates to carry out day to day surveillance across our markets, investigate what that surveillance uncovers, and help us build the programme out as the business grows.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Review and disposition surveillance alerts across our regulated markets, and record the reasoning behind each decision clearly enough that someone else can follow it.

 - Carry out analytical reviews that begin with trade and order data rather than with a system-generated alert.

 - Investigate escalated behaviour end to end: gather the data, reconstruct what happened, and write it up for presentation to senior compliance stakeholders.

 - Assess referrals raised from across the business and externally, and take forward the ones that warrant it.

 - Draft suspicious transaction and order reports and suspicious activity reports.

 - Produce management information and regulatory reporting for the entities we cover.

 - Contribute to surveillance platform and tooling work, including bringing new products and data sources into scope and testing that detection behaves as intended.

 - Use AI and automation tools to speed up evidence-gathering and case reconstruction, with human judgement over the final call. 

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - At least 2 years experience in trade surveillance, market abuse investigation or trading conduct inside a regulated firm, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, bank or comparable regulated trading business.

 - Working knowledge of the core market abuse typologies, for example spoofing, layering, wash trading, insider dealing, front running and ramping.

 - Experience reviewing and dispositioning surveillance alerts, and writing up what you found to a standard others can rely on.

 - Clear, evidence-first written communication. Your case files and escalations will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.

 - Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the oversight that regulated casework requires.

 - Based in the UK, Ireland, Cyprus, Malta, Brazil, Romania or Canada, with fluency in English. 

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required.

 - Hands-on use of a surveillance platform such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus or NICE Actimize.

 - SQL or a similar query tool for evidence-gathering.

 - Experience drafting suspicious transaction and order reports or suspicious activity reports.

 - Electronic communications surveillance experience.



Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.




OUR COMMITMENT

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.


We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.


As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

Lead infrastructure architecture and core platform development for the AI Native era, covering CI/CD, AIOps, observability, and monorepo engineering. Build platforms that support multiple programming languages across host-based and containerized environments.

Use platform engineering, intelligent tooling, and automated quality controls to enable developers and AI agents to work together, improving developer productivity, software quality, and production reliability.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Infrastructure Architecture and Evolution: Define platform architecture, technical standards, and roadmaps, balancing scalability, reliability, security, and cost. Lead critical component design, hands-on development, and implementation across teams.

•

AI Native Engineering Capabilities: Connect code, documentation, dependencies, test results, and runtime data into usable engineering context. Expose capabilities through APIs, CLIs, and SDKs for developers and agents to understand and review code, run tests, and resolve issues. Establish task evaluations, output validation, and execution permissions.

•

Infrastructure for Multiple Languages: Build extensible toolchains, dependency management, testing, and delivery capabilities for ecosystems such as Go, Java, Python, C++, and Rust. Use standard protocols and SDKs to support communication across languages, interface compatibility, and consistent telemetry, reducing platform integration effort.

•

Monorepo and Build Systems: Define repository structure, module boundaries, dependency policies, and code ownership to support changes across modules and independent service releases. Apply practices from systems such as Bazel and Buck2 to deliver incremental and reproducible builds, affected-test selection, remote caching, and remote execution.

•

CI/CD and Quality Engineering: Build shared platforms for builds, tests, artifacts, and releases across hosts and containers. Improve configuration governance, automated quality gates, progressive delivery, health verification, and rollback to shorten delivery cycles and reduce change risk.

•

Observability and Reliability: Unify metrics, logs, traces, and profiling, linking telemetry to code, configuration, dependencies, and deployments. Establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and alerting practices, and feed production findings back into engineering quality improvements.

•

AIOps and Automated Remediation: Combine telemetry, topology, change history, and operational knowledge to enable anomaly detection, incident investigation, root cause analysis, and controlled remediation. Use incident replay, evaluation, and feedback to reduce recovery time and repetitive operational work.

What We Look For In You

•

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 8 years of infrastructure or platform engineering experience, including 3 years in architecture or technical leadership.

•

Deep expertise in at least one of CI/CD, build systems, observability, or AIOps, with experience designing, implementing, and operating large production systems.

•

Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, distributed systems, and troubleshooting. Experience with deployment, configuration management, resource isolation, and production diagnostics in host-based and Kubernetes environments.

•

Experience building infrastructure for multiple languages, with an understanding of toolchain, dependency, and runtime differences. Ability to design shared platform interfaces and extensible language integrations.

•

Familiarity with open-source infrastructure practices originating at Google or Meta, such as build and dependency management with Bazel or Buck2, or cross-language communication and interface contracts with gRPC and Protocol Buffers. Experience evaluating, integrating, or optimizing relevant technologies.

•

Experience with automated testing, quality gates, and release engineering, using observability and reliability measures to improve delivery workflows.

•

Practical experience applying LLMs or agents to engineering workflows, including context construction, tool use, task orchestration, evaluation, and safe execution.

• Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, Java, C++, or Rust, with strong hands-on coding and debugging skills. Ability to drive implementation through design reviews, technical guidance, and collaboration across teams.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience at Google, Meta, or other leading technology companies, and a background in infrastructure, developer productivity, or AI Native engineering platforms, are preferred.

•

Leading large monorepos, build platforms supporting multiple languages, remote execution platforms, or enterprise developer productivity platforms.

•

Building AI-powered code review, test generation, incident diagnosis, or automated remediation systems and validating them in production.

•

Operating large environments spanning hosts and containers, improving software supply chain security, or contributing to relevant open-source projects.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

We thrive on progress – for our clients and for ourselves. Our organisational culture is ever-evolving, vibrant, diverse, global and results focused.

You’ll find our 700+ team currently across 12 locations and 9 time zones.

The Role
Our technology team thrives on inclusivity and collaboration, believing that diverse perspectives lead to great solutions. We foster a culture that champions individual growth, professional development, and work-life harmony. We're invested in your success and dedicated to supporting you every step of the way. We encourage our team to bring challenge thinking and fresh ideas to the table and our Agile approach empowers us to focus on outcomes. When we hire someone it's because they bring the skills, attitude and experience we're looking for....so we let you do what you're best at! Join us and be part of a community that's passionate about harnessing technology's potential to drive market leading solutions for our clients. Elevate your career in an environment where your ideas matter, your growth is nurtured, and your potential is limitless.

Our clients in more than 160 countries compare Pepperstone’s trading app, web trader and client area with the best consumer and fintech products they use every day. We want to set that bar higher. You’ll be the most senior hands-on engineer across our client-facing products, reporting directly to the CTO and providing senior technical leadership while remaining deeply hands-on.

As our Senior Principal Engineer - Platform Engineering, your key responsibilities include but may not be limited to:
• Shape our platform technical direction: Define the multi-year architecture across AI, cloud, networking, identity and data. You’ll help engineers and leaders navigate complex technical trade-offs and align around a clear direction, while identifying scaling, cost and resilience risks before they become issues.
• Stay hands-on with our toughest engineering challenges: Work directly on the most critical parts of our platform, writing production code and infrastructure as code and prototyping new approaches. You’ll take the lead on complex challenges across low-latency connectivity, high-throughput streaming, large data and identity migrations and platform reliability.
• Lead and shape AI-native engineering: Help design the core of Pepperstone’s AI platform, from model access and agent orchestration to tool connections, retrieval, evaluation and runtime governance. You’ll use AI coding and agent tools in your day-to-day work while helping establish the patterns, workflows and guardrails that enable our engineers to do the same.
• Create a great developer experience: Design the paved roads that make it easier for our engineers to build and ship, spanning service templates, CI/CD, observability, secrets, infrastructure as code and the developer platform. You’ll treat the platform as a product, using adoption and developer experience to help shape what we build next.
• Grow our technical capability: Mentor senior and staff engineers and help build an inclusive engineering community across locations. You’ll also contribute to hiring senior engineering talent and help set the bar for technical interviews.
• Partner with our technology leaders: Act as a trusted technical advisor to the CTO and Technology leadership team, bringing an independent, hands-on perspective to complex technical decisions. You’ll help ensure security, resilience, data protection and regulatory requirements are considered from the outset.

About you
• You bring extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and platforms with proven Staff or Principal-level impact within a scaled technology, SaaS or fintech environment.
• You’re still deeply hands-on, writing production code and infrastructure as code, reviewing code and prototyping solutions.
• You bring deep expertise across two or three areas such as AI platforms, cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, global networking, identity and authorisation or data and streaming platforms, with the ability to work credibly across the broader platform landscape.
• You have practical production experience with AI platforms, including LLM APIs, agent orchestration, retrieval, evaluation and AI observability, alongside AI-assisted engineering in your own day-to-day work.
• You understand how to build platforms as products, creating paved roads and developer experiences that are adopted and valued across multiple teams.
• You have experience running always-on, highly available systems and bring strong instincts around reliability, observability, performance and cost.
• You’ve successfully influenced technical direction across multiple teams without relying on direct authority, building trust through strong communication, technical judgement and collaboration.
• You’ve led significant migrations across live platforms and understand how to deliver change without disrupting the teams and clients that rely on them.
• You communicate complex technical decisions clearly to engineers, executives and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy mentoring senior and staff engineers.
• Experience with low-latency trading, market data, payments infrastructure, high-throughput streaming or identity and security at scale would be valuable but isn’t essential.

• Genuinely collaborative and friendly culture
• Flexible and hybrid working
